title: ProposalApproveRequest
description: The input of proposal.approve, as §26.1's table gives it: the canonical URI of the waiting proposal, and the fingerprint of the request the approver saw, which DSoR compares with the stored one (DSOR-APR-09; step 29's README, decision D1). The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /proposal/ part beside it is this tutorial's. Since step 41, the approval of a run also carries the run's fingerprint, its manifest_hash, and its totals per currency and per vendor, exactly as the approver was shown them, which DSoR compares with the run's own (DSOR-BAT-02a; step 41's README, decision D4).

payload_hash.description: The fingerprint of the stored request, sha256: and the hex digest of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON (DSOR-APR-02b).

manifest_hash.description: For a run only: the fingerprint of its lines in their order.

totals.description: For a run only: its totals per currency, as proposal.schema.json's totals.

vendor_totals.description: For a run only: its totals per vendor and currency. This tutorial's own field: proposal.schema.json has none for the counterparty.
